meaning: Kiryū Kazuma — protagonist; low-level enforcer in the Dojima Family (Tōjō Clan)
Majima Gorō — the second protagonist; ex-yakuza running Sōtenbori nightlife
"the Mad Dog of Shimano" — Majima Gorō's epithet
Nishikiyama Akira — Kiryū's sworn brother; fellow Dojima Family member
Oda Jun — Tachibana Real Estate's land-acquisition man; a major antagonist whose secret drives the plot
Tachibana Tetsu — head of Tachibana Real Estate; Majima's ally and Makoto's brother
Makoto Makimura — blind masseuse at the centre of the land-grab plot; Tachibana's sister
Wen Hai Lee — Chinese ex-hitman and Sōtenbori masseur who protects Makoto
Sagawa Tsukasa — Ōmi Alliance man who oversees and threatens Majima
Awano Hiroki — one of the three Dojima Family lieutenants (Taihei Association)
Kuze Daisaku — Dojima Family lieutenant (Kenno Clan); a recurring rival of Kiryū
Shibusawa Keiji — cold, ambitious Dojima Family lieutenant
Kashiwagi Osamu — Captain of the Kazama Family; Kiryū's ally
Kazama Shintarō — Kiryū's mentor and father figure; head of the Kazama Family
Sera Masaru — senior Tōjō Clan figure (later its patriarch)
Nishitani Homare — wild Kijin Clan patriarch (Ōmi Alliance) who shapes Majima's "Mad Dog" persona and knife-fighting style
the Shimano Family (patriarch Futoshi Shimano) — Majima's former family; source of his "Mad Dog of Shimano" epithet
Reina — bartender at Club Serena and a confidante of Kiryū
Kamoji — a homeless master who trains the protagonist in combat
Yamanoi — a manager at Tachibana Real Estate; close to Kazama, tied to the Finance King subplot
Bob Utsunomiya — an eccentric recurring merchant/informant
Marina Shiraishi — a figure in the real-estate / Finance King storyline
Youda — a supporting character
Billiken — an eccentric Sōtenbori shopkeeper who aids Majima
Bacchus — homeless combat master who trains Kiryū
the Dojima Family (堂島組), led by patriarch Sohei Dojima — Kiryū's parent yakuza family
the Tōjō Clan — Tokyo's dominant yakuza syndicate; the Dojima Family is one of its branches
the Ōmi Alliance — the great rival yakuza syndicate, based in Kansai
Kamurochō — Tokyo's red-light district; Kiryū's half of the game
Sōtenbori — Osaka's entertainment district; Majima's half of the game
